FACT_ID: sec08-R01 | anchor: A110
A solid red means stop and wait for green, a flashing red means stop and then go in turn like a stop sign, and a red arrow forbids only the arrow's direction. [A110]
Why it matters: group_hint red-signals; prereq_hint sec08-F07; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec08-F10, sec08-F12.
Source: [A110 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0110]

FACT_ID: sec08-R02 | anchor: A111
A solid yellow tells you to prepare to stop because red is next, whereas a flashing yellow tells you to yield and proceed when it is your right-of-way. [A111]
Why it matters: group_hint yellow-signals; prereq_hint sec08-F07; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec08-F13, sec08-F14.
Source: [A111 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0111]

FACT_ID: sec08-R03 | anchor: A111
Being caught in the intersection on a yellow means continue at the posted speed, not accelerate past it to clear the light. [A111]
Why it matters: group_hint yellow-signals; prereq_hint sec08-R02; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec08-F13.
Source: [A111 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0111]

FACT_ID: sec08-R04 | anchor: A112
A solid green lets you turn left only after yielding to oncoming traffic, while a green arrow gives you the right-of-way for that turn. [A112]
Why it matters: group_hint green-signals; prereq_hint sec08-F16; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec08-F17, sec08-F19.
Source: [A112 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0112]

FACT_ID: sec08-R05 | anchor: A109
A dark or broken traffic signal is handled as a four-way stop with a full stop and yielding to the right, not as a signal you may drive through. [A109]
Why it matters: group_hint signal-failure; prereq_hint sec08-F07; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec08-F09.
Source: [A109 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0109]

FACT_ID: sec08-R06 | anchor: A113
Orange warns of construction and maintenance, plain yellow warns of general road conditions, and fluorescent yellow-green warns of school, pedestrian and bicycle activity. [A113]
Why it matters: group_hint sign-colors; prereq_hint sec08-F21; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec08-F21, sec08-F22.
Source: [A113 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0113]

FACT_ID: sec08-R07 | anchor: A113
White marks a regulatory sign, green gives directions, blue points to motorist services and brown marks recreation or cultural areas. [A113]
Why it matters: group_hint sign-colors; prereq_hint sec08-R06; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec08-F21.
Source: [A113 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0113]

FACT_ID: sec08-R08 | anchor: A114
A stop sign always requires a full stop, whereas a yield sign requires slowing down and letting traffic that has the right-of-way cross first. [A114]
Why it matters: group_hint stop-and-yield; prereq_hint sec08-F07; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec08-F23.
Source: [A114 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0114]

FACT_ID: sec08-R09 | anchor: A114
A maximum speed limit is a ceiling for ideal conditions, while a minimum speed limit is a floor you must reach so you are not a hazard. [A114]
Why it matters: group_hint speed-limits; prereq_hint sec08-F24; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec08-F24, sec08-F25.
Source: [A114 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0114]

FACT_ID: sec08-R10 | anchor: A116
Do Not Enter warns you before you turn into a street from the wrong direction, while Wrong Way tells you that you are already traveling against traffic and must turn around. [A116]
Why it matters: group_hint wrong-direction; prereq_hint sec08-F28; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec08-F29.
Source: [A116 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0116]

FACT_ID: sec08-R11 | anchor: A108
The left lane is for passing slower traffic, but a carpool lane is never a passing lane and the shoulder is off limits unless officials or signs direct you there. [A108]
Why it matters: group_hint lane-use; prereq_hint sec08-F02; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec08-F03, sec08-F04.
Source: [A108 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0108]
